title: Shining the Holy Ark
native_title: シャイニング・ザ・ホーリィアーク
overview:
Activate the ancient legacy with the three sacred treasures!

A labyrinth revolution!

The legendary ark said to appear at the time of the eclipse has been shot down! Is its purpose the Holy Ark, or rebellion against the Creator? The fierce battle of Arthur and his mercenaries against the clutches of Enrich Castle and the nobles of a mysterious mansion that await them has begun!

A fresh story worthy of being called the new Shining and real-time gameplay - we present to you a truly next-generation turn-based RPG!

3種の神器で古代の遺産を発動させるのだ!

迷宮革命!

日蝕の時に現われるという伝説の方舟が墜とされた!その目的はホーリィアークか創造主への反抗か?待ち受けるエンリッチ城の魔手や謎の洋館の貴族にアーサーと傭兵たちとの熱い戦いが、切って落とされた!

新シャイニングと呼ぶに相応しい斬新なストーリーとリアルタイムなゲーム性、真に次世代のターン型RPGをここに贈ろう!
